name: AMAVI Canggu Bali
where: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.9, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Restaurant, bar lounge and pool on Jl. Pantai Berawa. Mediterranean concept with rice field views. The menu runs from nasi goreng and sate ayam to Angus ribeye and pizza.
best_for: Long lunches by the pool with a rice field view

name: Cafe Coach
where: Jl. Nelayan No.8, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Cafe Coach is an all-day café and wellness-coaching space on Jl. Nelayan in Canggu, known for a large breakfast-through-dinner menu — benedicts, poke bowls, burgers — plus coffee, cocktails, and hosted workshops.
best_for: An all-day café — big breakfast menu, coffee, and dinner into cocktails.
not_for: A quiet solo visit — the space also hosts coaching sessions and group events.

name: Mavammy
where: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.8, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Cafe and patisserie on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong. All-day breakfast and a dessert counter built on Belgian chocolate. Carrot cake with mango and passion fruit, and Lotus cheesecake. Strong wifi and air conditioning.
best_for: Cake and a laptop in the afternoon

name: Porch
where: Jl. Raya Semat No.1, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Coffee shop on Jl. Raya Semat. Thirteen kinds of cheesecake are the reason to come.

name: Pranava Yoga
why_its_here: Yoga studio at the Matrabali guesthouse on Jl. Pantai Berawa, opened in April 2016 by Vicki and Yuni. Rates are kept below the premium Canggu studios so local residents can practise too. Classes suit every level.
best_for: Yoga at a price the neighbourhood can pay

name: MAMU Ubud Cafe Shisha Hookah
where: Jl. Made Lebah, Mas, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia
why_its_here: Cafe and shisha lounge on Jl. Made Lebah in Mas. One of the widest shisha lists on the island, with Darkside, Musthave and Duft. Bowls, roasted vegetables, warm dips and shawarma. An air-conditioned lounge and a garden terrace.
not_for: Non-smokers and families - shisha is served throughout

name: Dewas Landing Cafe
where: Jl. Raya Uluwatu, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Cafe on Jl. Raya Uluwatu in Pecatu. A local gathering point that runs football watch parties.
best_for: Watching a match with the Pecatu crowd

name: HUMANS CAFE
where: 55J6+93R, Jl. Bali Cliff, Ungasan, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Cafe on Jl. Bali Cliff in Ungasan. Asian, Indonesian and European plates with specialty coffee. There is a playground for children.
best_for: Coffee while the children have somewhere to go

name: Lemanjá Uluwatu
where: Jl. Labuansait No.168, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Cafe, bar and coworking space with a pool on Jl. Labuansait. Breakfast starts at 07:30, with plates from 20,000 IDR. Pan-grilled prawns and tuna tataki, vegan quesadillas and plant-based pizza. Pastries alongside the cocktail list.
best_for: An early breakfast before the surf

name: Made’s Bakery Cafe Playground
where: Jl. Dharmawangsa No.85, Ungasan, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Bakery and cafe on Jl. Dharmawangsa in Ungasan, open since 2025 after growing out of a small warung. Pastries, desserts and coffee, with breakfast served all day and large portions. The playground is free to use.
best_for: Families who need the children occupied

name: Ula Cafe
where: Jl. Pantai Balangan, Ungasan, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Cafe on Jl. Pantai Balangan. Chef Mags builds the menu from scratch, with separate breakfast and mains lists. Woven textures, ocean air and vinyl in the background. Wifi and power outlets throughout.
best_for: A slow breakfast with a laptop
not_for: A weekend evening - it closes at 16:00 on Saturday and Sunday

name: Uluwatu Collective
why_its_here: Gym above Pepito Express on Jl. Raya Uluwatu, high-ceilinged and open-air. CrossFit, Metcon, HIIT, weightlifting, functional training and yoga run as group classes. Access comes daily, weekly, monthly or yearly; a month is 1,450,000 IDR.
best_for: Group classes rather than a solo gym floor
not_for: An evening session - it closes at 19:00

name: De Maison Bali Restaurant & Bar
where: Jl. Tukad Badung No.166C, Renon, Denpasar Selatan, Kota Denpasar, Bali 80223, Indonesia
why_its_here: Coffee shop on Jl. Tukad Badung in Renon, Denpasar.
best_for: Working from a cafe in Denpasar

name: Warung Mangga Madu
best_for: budget travelers wanting classic Indonesian comfort food close to central Ubud
not_for: diners seeking a fine-dining atmosphere or an extensive wine list
